name: Jarvan IV
text: Keywords: Barrier. When you attack, pay my cost to summon me Challenging the strongest enemy. Level up: Allies have survived 3+ strikes from enemy blockers.

name: Swiftwing Flight
text: Keywords: Challenger. Play: Create a Silverwing Vanguard, Blinding Assault, or Fleetfeather Tracker in hand. Attack: Give other Challenging allies +1|+1 this round.

name: Gallant Rider
text: The first time I Challenge an enemy, transform me into Vanguard Cavalry.

name: Kennen
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. When I'm summoned, create a Mark of the Storm in hand. Level up: You've summoned the same ally 5+ times.

name: Tristana
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Impact. I have +1|+0 for each multi-region ally you've summoned this game. When you summon a multi-region ally, grant it +1|+0. Level up: You've summoned 5+ multi-region allies.

name: Veigar
text: When I'm summoned, create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. Round Start: Grant your Darkness everywhere 1 extra damage. Level up: You've dealt 12+ damage with Darkness.

name: Rumble
text: Play: Discard up to 3 cards to grant allied Rumbles everywhere Impact for the first, Quick Attack for the second, and SpellShield for the third. Level up: I've seen Mecha Yordle allies deal 12+ damage.

name: Yordle Ranger
text: Keywords: Scout. Attack: Grant allies with equal or less power than me +0|+1.

name: Poppy
text: Attack: Grant allies with equal or less power than me +1|+1. Level up: I've attacked with allies 3 times.

name: Bandle Gunners
text: I cost 1 less for each multi-region ally you've summoned this game. When I'm summoned, grant me 3 Impact.

name: The Bandle Tree
text: Keywords: Landmark. Round Start: Create a follower from a new region in hand. Then, if I've seen allies from 10 regions, win the game.

name: Yordle Contraption
text: Destroy a landmark or create 2 random multi-region followers in hand.

name: Yordle Captain
text: When you summon another ally with equal or less Power than me, grant it +1|+1.

name: Buster Shot
text: I cost 2 less if you have a Tristana or if you've played cards from 4+ regions this game. Deal 3 to a unit.

name: Cloud Stance
text: Give an ally +2|+0 and "Round End: Recall me" this round.

name: The Arsenal
text: When I'm summoned, grant me a random keyword for each allied landmark you've destroyed this game. When you destroy an allied landmark, grant me a random keyword.

name: Tornado Warrior
text: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 and a random keyword. I keep these stat buffs and keywords when I'm Recalled.

name: Double Tap
text: An ally strikes an enemy. If the ally is multi-region, it strikes the enemy again.

name: Bandle City Mayor
text: Each round, the first multi-region unit you play costs 1 less. Play: Manifest a multi-region follower.

name: Yordles in Arms
text: Give allies +2|+2 this round. If you've played cards from 4+ regions, give allies +3|+3 instead.

name: Transposition
text: Recall an ally. The next ally you play this round with equal or less cost, costs 0 instead.

name: Hothead
text: Attack: Grant the top champion in your deck +1|+1 and a random keyword.

name: Treasured Trash
text: Fill your hand with random cards. They cost 0 and areFleeting. You can only play 3 more cards this round.

name: Bandle Painter
text: Keywords: Augment. Play: Discard 1 to create a multi-region follower in hand and reduce its cost by 1.

name: Yordle Smith
text: Attack: Give allies with equal or less power than me Quick Attack this round.

name: Loping Telescope
text: Play: Manifest a Celestial that costs 3 or less, Epic, or multi-region follower.

name: Curious Shellfolk
text: When you pick a non-champion card from randomly selected options, create a copy in hand and reduce its cost by 1.

name: God-Willow Seedling
text: Keywords: Landmark, Countdown. Play: Recall an ally to summon an Ephemeral copy of it. Countdown 3: Summon another Ephemeral copy of it.

name: Children of the Forest
text: Recall an ally, or spend 8 mana to summon Ephemeral copies of the 3 strongest followers you've Recalled this game.

name: Memory's Cloak
text: Pick an ally being targeted by enemy Fast spells, Slow spells, or Skills with only 1 allied target. Stop them.

name: Sandseer
text: Keywords: Fearsome. When I'm summoned, draw 1. If you drew a landmark, repeat this effect.

name: Sion
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. When I'm discarded, grant your strongest ally Overwhelm and place me into your deck. I have +1|+0 for each card you've discarded this game (Max +7|+0). Level up: You've discarded or summoned 35+ Power.

name: Avatar of the Tides
text: Keywords: Imbue. If you would get a mana gem, instead refill your spell mana. When you play a spell, create in hand a random spell that costs 3 or less and grant it Fleeting.

name: Marai Greatmother
text: When I'm summoned, create in deck 5 random 6+ cost spells and reduce their costs to 3.

name: Corina, Mastermind
text: Play: Plant 5 Flashbomb Traps in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck or activate the effects of all traps in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck.

name: Catalogue of Regrets
text: Keywords: Landmark. Round Start: Create in hand a Fleeting copy of a non-Fleeting spell you played last round.

name: Senna
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Missing Translation. When I'm summoned or Attack: Create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. Your damage and kill spells accelerate to Fast. Level up: I've seen you kill 3+ units with spells or an allied Lucian die.

name: Dess & Ada
text: When I'm summoned, create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. Your next Darkness this round costs 0 and gains “I deal damage to all enemy targets.”

name: Camphor, the Doubt
text: When I'm summoned, if you've targeted allies in 4 different rounds, grant me Spellshield, Overwhelm, and Challenger.

name: Pantheon
text: Keywords: Overwhelm, Barrier. Level up: You've targeted allies in 5+ different rounds.

name: Gorlith the Unscalable
text: Keywords: Formidable, Tough. Play: Swap my Health and your Nexus' Health. I can't be blocked by enemies with less Health than me.

name: Might of the Vanguard
text: To play, spend all of your mana. Summon a Dauntless Vanguard and grow its stats to that amount. If 9+ mana was spent, grant other Elite allies +2|+2.

name: Petricite Stag
text: Keywords: Support. Support: I take all damage for my supported ally this round.

name: Lord Broadmane
text: Keywords: Missing Translation. Play: Deal 2 to an enemy. Your Fast spells, Slow spells, and Skills have "When I damage a Stunned or damaged enemy, kill it."

name: Strategic Execution
text: Stun 2 enemies or spend 6 mana to summon a Legion General.

name: Legion Deserter
text: Keywords: Fearsome. I gain all allied everywhere buffs.

name: Manasoul Student
text: Each round, the first time you play a Fast spell, Slow spell, or Skill, I play Magic Embers.

name: Celestial Trifecta
text: Invoke a low, medium, and high cost Celestial card.

name: Mystic Vortex
text: Keywords: Countdown, Landmark. When I'm summoned or when I count down, plant 3 Chimes in your deck. Countdown 2: Draw 1.

name: Starhound Pack
text: My Fated buffs are granted to allied Starhound Packs everywhere.

name: Mikhael's Blessing
text: Grant an ally +1|+2 and remove all negative keywords from it.

name: Hunting Boar
text: Keywords: Can't Block, Last Breath. Last Breath: Get an empty mana gem.

name: Cracking Ice
text: Grant an enemy "Frostbite me at the next Round Start."

name: Proximity Puffcap
text: Deal 1 to a unit. If one of your traps or boons activated this round, deal 3 to it instead.

name: Maduli, The Gatekeeper
text: When I'm summoned, plant a Chime on the top card of your deck, then double the boons in your deck.

name: Kinkou's Call
text: Summon a Keeper of Masks now or at the next Round Start. Draw 1.

name: Storm of Blades
text: For the rest of the game, when you Blade Dance, summon another attacking Blade. Blade Dance 1.

name: The Maker
text: Play: Recall a unit with less Power than me.

name: Windswept Hillock
text: Keywords: Landmark. When I'm summoned, draw Yasuo and Stun the Strongest enemy. When you gain the attack token, Stun the Strongest enemy.

name: Sputtering Songspinner
text: Pick one of two new 2 cost spells to create in hand and set its cost to 0 this round. Repeat two more times.

name: Solitude
text: When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk. When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant it a random keyword.

name: Scavenged Camocloaker
text: Grant an ally Elusive and "Nexus Strike: Draw 1."

name: Salvaged Scrap
text: To play, discard up to 2 cards. Create that many followers from your regions that cost 1 more and reduce their costs by 1.

name: Illaoi
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. Attack: Spawn 1, then I gain Power equal to your strongest Tentacle's Power this round. Level up: I've seen myself or allied Tentacles deal 15+ damage.

name: Wharf Rat
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. I have +1|+0 for each different round you've damaged the enemy Nexus.

name: Answered Prayer
text: Spawn 2, or spend 5 mana to Spawn 4 instead.

name: Ransom Riches
text: Manifest a follower you can afford.

name: Void Abomination
text: Keywords: Evolve. When I'm summoned, grant me all positive keywords allies have had this game. When an ally has a new positive keyword, grant it to me.

name: Hive Herald
text: Keywords: Evolve. Play: Grant a unit and me each other's positive keywords.

name: Baccai Witherclaw
text: Play: Grant an enemy Vulnerable. When an enemy is Challenged, give it -2|-0 this round.

name: Glory's Call
text: I cost 2 less for each different Ascended ally you've summoned this game. Manifest a card from the Emperor's Deck with cost 9 or less.

name: Voidling
text: Keywords: Evolve. While in hand, I have a random keyword that changes each round. When I'm summoned, grant me this keyword.

name: Gwen
text: Keywords: Hallowed, Quick Attack. Attack: When another ally gains Power from Hallowed, so do I. Drain 2 from the enemy Nexus. Level up: I've dealt 10+ damage.
